input.quote: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
input.rationale: The only grant running to us is § 2(a) (Interface licence, term-limited under § 2(c)). It names no affiliates and provides no path to add them (§ 8(c) confines Interface access to Client's own officers, employees and agents), and § 15 permits transfer of rights only with TrueLink's prior written approval, with an exception limited to a financially responsible affiliate rather than a successor in an M&A transaction. Both fallback elements therefore fail, so we target the fallback: affiliates covered on written notice and licence transferability to an M&A successor. We add a Client-only transfer right in § 2 instead of widening the mutual assignment exception in § 15, and conform § 8(c) so licensed affiliates' personnel may access the Interface. The preferred perpetual/irrevocable and breach-only termination points are not pursued, as this is a term subscription-style licence.

mappings.element: Customer's affiliates are covered on written notice.
The licence is transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to Client affiliates on written notice and permit transfer to an M&A successor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the Interface licence to our affiliates upon written notice and made it transferable to a successor in a merger or acquisition, consistent with our fallback licence-scope position.

ops.text: Affiliates and Successors. Upon written notice from Client to TrueLink, the license granted under section 2(a) extends to the affiliates of Client identified in that notice, and Client may transfer the license to a successor in a merger or acquisition transaction without TrueLink's approval.

ops.oldText: its officers, employees, and agents as may be approved by Client
ops.newText: its and its licensed affiliates' officers, employees, and agents as may be approved by Client
